theme: DYNOTEARS against CausalNex 0.12.2, the authors' implementation
build: Andrey pre-release builds: the 0.13.0 branch of 31 October 2026 for the Gaussian, centered exponential, Barabasi-Albert, and out-of-claim settings, and the 0.14.0 branch of 3 November 2026 for the exponential noise of mean 1 and the Barabasi-Albert graphs at 50 steps; refitted on the 0.14.0 build, every recorded Andrey fit up to 50 variables and 20 at 100 variables return the same graph (identity)

regimes.dynotears_paper: Erdos-Renyi same-step graph of mean degree 2, Erdos-Renyi lagged graph of mean in-degree 2 with self-lags, Gaussian noise, raw scale (in claim)
regimes.dynotears_paper_exponential: the same graphs, exponential noise of scale 1 with its mean subtracted, raw scale (in claim)
regimes.dynotears_paper_ba_sbm: Barabasi-Albert same-step graph (2 edges per new node), two-block lagged graph of mean in-degree 2, Gaussian noise, raw scale, 500 and 50 steps, up to 50 variables (in claim)
regimes.dynotears_paper_standardized: dynotears_paper with every column z-scored (out of claim)
regimes.dynotears_paper_uncentered: the same graphs, exponential noise of scale 1 not centered, the noise of the paper's simulations (Appendix B.4), raw scale (in claim)
regimes.dynotears_sin_tanh: sin of each same-step parent and tanh of each lagged parent in place of the linear terms, Gaussian noise (out of claim)
regimes.length 50 at n500: dynotears_paper at 50 steps with the defaults (out of claim)

verdict_rule: D = SHD(Andrey) - SHD(CausalNex) per series on the series both finished; the mean D with its percentile bootstrap 95% interval (10,000 resamples); a setting in claim with at least 10 pairs is worse when the interval lies above 0, better when below, a tie otherwise; a worse setting is run again on 20 fresh seeds (20-39, the replication in its row) and counts as worse only if the replication's interval also lies above 0; a better setting is run again the same way and counts as better only if its replication's interval also lies below 0. Settings with claim 'out' are reported, not judged
fit_protocol: one timed fit per series, no warm-up, one BLAS thread on one core, four fits at a time on four cores, a 3600 s wall cap per fit; andrey_cpu_s and comparator_cpu_s are the medians of the fits' CPU time, cpu_ratio the median over the paired series of CausalNex's CPU time over Andrey's, with its bootstrap 95% interval
error_metric: each entry's own, in its error_metric: the edge SHD over the window, as the mean over the paired series
complete_definition: true when every setting has at least 10 paired series (both packages finished); no fit reached its cap
seeds_note: 20 series per setting in claim (seeds 0-19), 10 per setting out of claim (seeds 0-9); replications on seeds 20-39 of every setting judged worse or better
identity: the 0.14.0 build's tie ranks keep the column order of all 640 stored series, the fit's code is otherwise unchanged, and refitted on that build 580 of 580 recorded Andrey fits (every one up to 50 variables, and the 20 of exponential noise at 100 variables and 50 steps on seeds 0-19) return the same structure_hash

centering.what: Andrey's fit with its columns not centered (the second moments in place of the covariance), on the exponential-noise series of mean 0 at 50 steps and 100 variables; D is a paired mean difference of SHD with its bootstrap 95% interval
centering.weights_of_true_edges_seeds_0_19: mean magnitude centered minus not centered: same-step -0.014, self-lags -0.017, cross-lags -0.002; the share of true edges whose magnitude shrinks: 51%, 54%, 41%

differences.500_steps: in claim, 34 of the 280 paired series end on a different graph; CausalNex on centered columns (fitted on those 34 alone) returns Andrey's graph on 29. Of the other 5, Andrey's graph changes on 4 when the data are multiplied by 1 + 1e-12 noise or the columns are fitted in their given order. On the fifth (exponential noise, 20 variables, seed 1) neither moves either package's graph; the one edge that differs is a true lagged edge of weight 0.10026 in Andrey's fit and 0.09975 in CausalNex's on centered columns, against the threshold 0.1, the largest weight difference between the two fits being 0.0048
differences.50_steps: every run has the centered arm (same_graph in each row's centered block). At 100 variables, on 4 exponential-noise series where Andrey's graph differs from CausalNex's on centered columns: Andrey stops on h_tol (h_final below 1e-8) with no edge removed by the cycle repair, refitting at rho_max 1e20 keeps the graph on 3 and matches CausalNex on none, and multiplying the data by 1 + 1e-12 noise changes the graph on 3 of the 4 (SHD -5, +4, -2; on one series to CausalNex's graph exactly), the columns in their given order on 2
differences.mean_1: with exponential noise of mean 1, 36 paired series end on a graph other than CausalNex's on centered columns, 13 of them at 50 steps and 100 variables; 27 were traced (4 of those 13). On 24 the data multiplied by 1 + 1e-12 noise or the columns fitted in their given order changes Andrey's graph; on the other 3 the one edge that differs has a weight within 0.002 of the threshold in both fits (0.19848 and 0.20013 against 0.2; 0.09856 and 0.10018, and 0.09848 and 0.10031, against 0.1)

methods.setting: lambda1=0.05, w_threshold=0.3, lag_threshold=0.1, tau_max=1 (the defaults, the paper's for 500 steps)
methods.comparator_setting: from_pandas_dynamic(p=1, lambda_w=0.05, lambda_a=0.05, w_threshold=0.0), then same-step weights kept at abs(w) >= 0.3 and lagged ones at abs(a) >= 0.1
methods.output: window over lags 0 and 1: a same-step DAG and lag-1 links, self-lags included
methods.hardware: Intel Core i7-7820X, 1 core per fit, 1 BLAS thread
methods.build: Andrey pre-release builds: the 0.13.0 branch of 31 October 2026 for the Gaussian, centered exponential, Barabasi-Albert, and out-of-claim settings, and the 0.14.0 branch of 3 November 2026 for the exponential noise of mean 1 and the Barabasi-Albert graphs at 50 steps
methods.error_metric: edge SHD over lags 0 and 1 (Pamfil et al. 2020, Appendix B.7): a same-step pair whose state differs (missing, extra, or reversed) costs 1, a lagged link in one graph and not the other costs 1; andrey_shd_mean, comparator_shd_mean, and empty_shd_mean hold their means over the paired series, and the lag0 and lagged fields the two parts
